decision.observation: Smoke has cleared. The rock face at the top of the beach looks unchanged — the same notch and shadow shapes as before the blast; no crater or new opening visible. The open case with the SCOUT CANNON badge sits before me.
decision.hypothesis: The blast had no visible effect on the rock, so the fuse may have just burned off rather than opened a passage — or the charge needed to be aimed. Back off a step to survey the outcrop for any new hole.
decision.memory: Lighting the fuse created a rising fireball but left the rock face unchanged.
